summary: Completed comprehensive testing of criticality features: filtering, dashboard breakdown, critical materials page, auto-classify, Excel exports, and analysis columns. All 12 backend APIs and all frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/items?criticality=1 returns only criticality 1 items (2 items found)
GET /api/items?criticality=2 returns only criticality 2 items (2 items found)
GET /api/items?criticality=3 returns only criticality 3 items (14,997 items found)
GET /api/items?criticality=all returns all items (15,001 total)
GET /api/dashboard returns by_criticality array with 3 tiers (criticality, label, count, value, pct)
GET /api/dashboard/critical returns complete data (total_count, total_value, reorder_count, below_min_count, by_tier with 2 tiers, at_risk list)
GET /api/export/inventory returns Excel with 'Criticality Label' and 'Avg Yearly Consumption' columns
GET /api/export/critical returns Excel with only Tier 1 & 2 items (4 items)
POST /api/items/auto-classify with dry_run=true returns preview without modifying data (scanned 14,997 items, 1 change suggested)
POST /api/items/auto-classify with dry_run=false applies changes (1 item reclassified)
GET /api/analysis includes avg_monthly_consumption and avg_yearly_consumption in stats
All items have valid criticality field (1, 2, or 3)
Dashboard: Items by Criticality card displays 3 tiles with counts and values
Dashboard: Clicking criticality tile navigates to /inventory?criticality=N
Inventory: 'Crit' column visible in table header
Inventory: Criticality filter dropdown present and functional
Inventory: Filtering by criticality 1 shows only Tier 1 items (2 items)
Inventory: Criticality badges (1, 2, 3) display correctly in Crit column
Analysis: 'Avg / Mo' column header visible
Analysis: 'Avg / Yr' column header visible
Critical Materials: All 4 KPI cards visible (total count, total value, reorder count, below min count)
Critical Materials: Tier 1 and Tier 2 breakdown cards visible with status counts
Critical Materials: At-risk table visible with critical items
Critical Materials: Export button present
Settings: Auto-Classify card with toggle, Preview and Apply buttons present
Settings: Preview Suggestions button shows results with tier counts
Settings: Apply button correctly disabled when no changes to apply
Inventory: Export Excel button present
